complete_examples.text: Non-stationary Nonzero mean Nonlinear stochastic Probability density function A B S T R A C T An extended exponential-polynomial-closure (EPC) method is presented in this paper for solving the non-stationary nonzero mean probabilistic solutions of nonlinear stochastic oscillators under both additive and multiplicative Gaussian white noise excitations.

The non-stationary nonzero mean probabilistic solutions of nonlinear stochastic oscillators are investigated under both additive and multiplicative Gaussian white noise excitations by using the extended EPC method.
